subject: CloudRoot onboarding — PO issuance & line-item corrections
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah@cloudroot.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudRoot Procurement <procurement@cloudroot.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: CloudRoot onboarding - provisional PO request and spend cap details

Hi Aditya / Monica,

Thanks for the rapid intro. Attached is our completed onboarding form and the initial quote from our sales team (CloudRoot_Onboarding_Form.pdf, initial_quote.xlsx). A few things we want to flag so procurement can provision a PO:

- Requested provisional monthly spend cap: $50,000 (we expect first quarter to run near this level)
- Two line items on the quote: CR-API-1 (consumption) and CR-SUPPORT-1 (premium support) — the quantities on the quote are placeholders and need procurement mapping
- Vendor info included on the onboarding form: CloudRoot Inc, TIN 12-3456789, bank: FirstWest (ACH details in form)

Can you confirm whether Redwood will issue a provisional PO or a provisional PO range we can include on our billing? If possible, we'd like a PO number to attach to our initial invoices while finance completes the final approval.

Also: we have one special request — is it possible to split the consumption SKU into two line items (US and APAC regions) so we can route invoices to different cost centers later? Happy to provide the suggested split by quantity.

Appreciate the help — happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Sarah Lee
Head of Partnerships, CloudRoot AI
procurement@cloudroot.ai

Attachments: CloudRoot_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf), initial_quote.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudRoot Procurement <procurement@cloudroot.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CloudRoot onboarding - provisional PO request and spend cap details

Monica / Rishi,

Forwarding CloudRoot's onboarding packet. Quick notes / request from procurement ops:

- Confirm vendor TIN and ACH are present on the onboarding form (they are).
- They want a provisional PO (PO range or single PO) to attach to invoices while Finance finalizes credit approval.
- They asked whether we can split the consumption SKU by region; if we can't provide separate PO line items, we should at least provide a single PO and attach a ledger crosswalk mapping later.

Action items for procurement ops (can you take):
1) Allocate a provisional PO number or provisional PO range (format PRV-CR-XXXXX) and reserve it in the ledger; this will let the vendor attach something to their invoices.
2) Create a simple line-item crosswalk: map the quote SKUs to our internal cost centers and indicate whether the SKU should be split across US/APAC buckets. See attached vendor-intake-sheet.xlsx for the intake fields I want captured.
3) Hold final issuance until Finance signs off on the spend cap; Finance will likely ask for a short term cap window (30-60 days) while we validate consumption.

If you need me to introduce the vendor to Finance directly, I can loop them in.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor-intake-sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudRoot Procurement <procurement@cloudroot.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudRoot onboarding - provisional PO request and spend cap details

Thanks Aditya — taking this on.

Sarah / procurement team,

Quick read of the attachments — two small corrections we need for ledger hygiene before reserving a provisional PO:
1) The initial_quote.xlsx lists CR-API-1 quantity as 1,000 units; based on pricing notes that should read 10,000 consumption units. Please confirm corrected quantity.
2) The support SKU CR-SUPPORT-1 should be a service line (not product) and billed monthly. Can you update the quote to mark SKU type = "service" and provide a monthly rate?

Proposed path:
- I'll reserve PRV-CR-004300 as a provisional PO token in our staging ledger today for tracking purposes (status = reserved, not issued).
- We will not publish a final PO until Finance approves the $50k monthly cap; provisional token allows invoices to be received and routed to a temporary bucket.
- Once the vendor sends a corrected quote (with corrected quantities and SKU types), we'll update the crosswalk and either split the line items (US/APAC) or flag for a single PO with internal split codes.

I attached a short CSV showing the mapping I intend to use for the crosswalk (lineitem-corrections.csv). If you can, Sarah, please return a corrected quote by Monday so we can move the final issuance through Finance next week.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: lineitem-corrections.csv (text/csv)

On Fri, Jun 12, 2026 at 10:03 AM Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Monica / Rishi,
>
> Forwarding CloudRoot's onboarding packet. Quick notes / request from procurement ops:
> ...

From: Sarah Lee <sarah@cloudroot.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudRoot onboarding - provisional PO request and spend cap details

Hi Monica / Aditya,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for reserving a provisional token. Attached is an updated quote that fixes the quantities and marks the support SKU as a monthly service (see PO-CR-004321 packet attached). We updated CR-API-1 to 10,000 units and added a small APAC split suggestion row.

We appreciate the reserve PRV-CR-004300 — can you confirm the provisional token mapping to the issued PO when the ledger move happens? Also, for invoicing, what email and cost-center code should we use? Our AP team needs that for the first invoice.

We've attached the executed PO as a PDF for records (PO-CR-004321.pdf) and included a DocuSign link for the final SOW (https://www.docusign.net/CLM/DocID/7a9f3e). Let us know if Finance needs any additional backup (usage projections or customer references).

Best,
Sarah Lee
Head of Partnerships, CloudRoot AI

Attachments: PO-CR-004321.pdf (application/pdf), corrected_quote.xlsx (spreadsheet)
snippet: CloudRoot requests provisional PO to attach to invoices; Procurement reserves PRV-CR-004300 and requests corrected quote before final issuance. PO-CR-004321 subsequently attached.
notes: Reserved provisional token pattern PRV-CR-004300 used to track vendor invoices while Finance reviews $50k/month cap. Internal crosswalk file created for ledger reconciliation.
